label: Reaches the nearest key destination in time

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Every edge's state: the comps_state ndtools reads.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Survival if the nearest key destination is reached within the system event's target_add_h hours of the intact network's travel time, else Fail: ndtools' system state, which rsr's rules classify.

description: For each origin node (bind it to the non-key nodes), whether it still reaches the nearest node marked key_destination in time, over the open edges, by ndtools' eval_travel_time_to_nearest. Each edge's weight is length_km / avg_speed_kph, in hours; the travel time itself is internal to the judgement, not a BN node. Joint across the Node plate: every origin reads the same edge states in the same sample.
